Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}

    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has a clique of AT LEAST k vertices: k vertices with an
edge between every two of them.

Edge cases: k <= 0 is always yes. k = 1 is yes whenever n >= 1. k > n is
always no.

TARGET = IndependentSet
Independent Set.

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has an independent set of AT LEAST k vertices: k
vertices with no edge between any two of them.

Edge cases: k <= 0 is always yes. k > n is always no. With no edges,
every set of vertices is independent.

WORKING DIRECTORY: /tmp/reduction-zu6uzw2y

{"command":"cd /tmp/reduction-zu6uzw2y && cat > reduce.py <<'EOF'
"""Polynomial-time reduction from Clique to Independent Set.

A set of vertices is a clique in a graph G if and only if it is an
independent set in the complement graph of G.  Therefore the reduction
keeps n and k unchanged and replaces the edge list by the list of all
pairs that are not edges of G.
"""


def reduce(instance):
    """Return the complement-graph instance for the Clique instance.

    Input and output are both dicts of the form
        {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
    as documented for Clique and IndependentSet.
    """
    n = instance["n"]
    edges = instance["edges"]
    k = instance["k"]

    # Store undirected edges canonically so that [u, v] and [v, u] are
    # treated as the same edge.
    present = {frozenset(edge) for edge in edges}

    complement_edges = [
        [u, v]
        for u in range(n)
        for v in range(u + 1, n)
        if frozenset((u, v)) not in present
    ]

    return {"n": n, "edges": complement_edges, "k": k}
EOF

A set of vertices is a clique in a graph G if and only if it is an
independent set in the complement graph of G.  Therefore the reduction
keeps n and k unchanged and replaces the edge list by the list of all
pairs that are not edges of G.

def reduce(instance):
    """Return the complement-graph instance for the Clique instance.
